commit.message:
nav2_common: Depend on osrf_pycommon system package in Lyrical+ (#6492)

In Lyrical, all core packages depend on system python3-osrf-pycommon
instead of ROS package osrf_pycommon (see https://github.com/ros2/launch/pull/817).

Do the same here to avoid potential (but unlikely) conflict in
versions of these packages. This is also useful for package managers
like Nix, which are more strict about dependency conflicts.

Signed-off-by: Michal Sojka <michal.sojka@cvut.cz>

commit.message:
fix(nav2_behavior_tree): cancel goal when halted before acknowledgement (#6445)

BtActionNode::halt() skipped cancellation while a goal was sent but the
action server had not yet returned the goal handle (future_goal_handle_
pending, goal_handle_ still null), leaving the accepted goal orphaned on
the server. Wait briefly for the pending acknowledgement during halt(),
bounded by server_timeout_, then reuse the existing per-goal cancellation
path. Unlike the goal-response-timeout path this does not use
async_cancel_all_goals(), so unrelated goals are unaffected.

Adds a deterministic regression test that halts a node while the goal
acknowledgement is gated, then verifies the accepted goal is cancelled.

Fixes #6426

Signed-off-by: Maharshi Kamleshkumar Barot <barotmaharshi393@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Maharshi Kamleshkumar Barot <barotmaharshi393@gmail.com>
